clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Alterac Mountains, Worn Stone Token enchantments have faded, though Dalaran crafted them to command elementals. The tokens remain with Dalaran personnel, from mages to laborers.

Dalaran’s magi command elementals with talismans that bend beings from other realms to their will. Worn Stone Tokens are depleted versions of these implements. Theurgists and summoners carry them, as do Dalaran laborers and guards stationed around the ruins and internment camps of Alterac. Their presence shows how deeply elemental binding reaches into Dalaran’s daily work.

At Tarren Mill, the Forsaken watch the nearby wizards. Magus Voidglare seeks Worn Stone Tokens to study Dalaran’s methods of enslaving elementals. Keeper Bel'varil directs agents to gather worn, inert tokens first. These let the Magus examine basic enchanting techniques safely before attempting more potent, volatile conduits.
